title: Croupier Studio — editable presentation policies
description: JSON editing surface, not a game-engine contract. Runtime validateProject additionally enforces ordered source metadata, cross-references, stable baseline identity, category-specific bounded predicates and all 64 unique dealer/event lines.

mediaPolicy.description: Optional per-folder selection policy. Missing entries are manual only. Legacy project lines are preserved but do not supply candidates for manifest-owned dealers.

legacyClipPolicy.description: Exact Lab-owned bindings for the existing four-dealer engine and explicit staged destinations. Old BO picks are review-only; never copy uncertain destinations or recorded speech.

lanes.description: Optional presentation lanes. A saved project without this key stays valid; normalization supplies the mobile-phone lane. An explicit empty list is kept.

clipLabels.description: Optional display names keyed by clip id. Files and hashes are not renamed.

zones.description: Optional zone ids from the cloud zone store. The documents themselves stay outside the project.

colors.description: Optional table colors the lane allows, lowercase #rrggbb.

laneProbe.description: Optional per-lane probe. When the object is absent, openclaw.probe applies.

laneIdle.description: Optional idle baseline for the lane. No game reader yet.
